entry_conditions: `coldpress init` has scaffolded the project (coldpress.yaml + .claude/ + CLAUDE.md present)
Butler's `orient` skill has run and handed off to `intake`

acceptance_checks.description: `.coldpress/local-config.yaml` has `phase_1_completed: true` — set by intake Step 6 when all prior steps exited cleanly
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` from the last incomplete step. Butler's orient Step 1 will detect `partial_completion` and resume automatically.

acceptance_checks.description: Phase-1 working-mode fields present in coldpress.yaml: user.preferred_ides, user.cadence, user.team_shape — written by intake Step 4
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 4 (working-mode) to capture IDE preference, cadence, and team shape.

acceptance_checks.description: butler.display_name is set in coldpress.yaml (default 'Butler' is acceptable — warn level)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 4 Q4 to confirm or rename Butler.

acceptance_checks.description: Sacred document `_context/sacred/context.md` exists (seeded by intake Step 3 with one-sentence intent + frontmatter)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 3 (intent-seed) to write the seed context.md. Phase 2 pre-project-interview will expand it.

acceptance_checks.description: The seed `_context/sacred/context.md` frontmatter validates against schemas/sacred-docs/context.schema.json
acceptance_checks.remediation: Inspect context.md frontmatter. intake Step 3 runs validate-schema before committing the write — if you hand-edited the file, revert to the seed shape.

acceptance_checks.description: `.coldpress/graph/graph.json` exists and is non-empty. WARN-level (not block) per deep-dive architectural note 8 — graph prime can fail gracefully. If `.coldpress/local-config.yaml needs_graph_rebuild: true`, the gate report surfaces `graph_rebuild_error` and continues.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `coldpress graph rebuild` (or let orient Step 1 retry next session). Check `coldpress doctor` if it keeps failing — often a Python version / Graphify dep issue.

acceptance_checks.description: Each of the 5 `_input/` subfolders (assets, vendor, raw, legacy, reference) has content OR a `.intake-skip` marker placed by intake Step 1
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `intake` Step 1 (material-solicitation) and either drop material into each subfolder or explicitly skip it.
